# Change review

A change an agent proposes, shown as the reviewer reads it, with Approve, Request changes and Reject under it.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

An agent proposes a change; a person reviews it and decides. The change is shown as the reviewer needs it — files as diffs, records as fields before → after — and the decision sits under it.

- **Three decisions, one weight.** Approve, Request changes and Reject are the same size and variant, in one row, each a glyph and a word. A review screen that makes Approve the ink button has decided for the reviewer; on a change an agent will apply, that is a defect. Reject is not red: rejecting is the safe choice.
- **A no needs a reason.** The agent acts on it — it revises the change or stops proposing it. With the reason empty, Reject and Request changes say what is missing in words, move focus to the field and do not call `onDecide`. The hint says so before anyone fails it.
- **The outcome replaces the form** and takes focus, so it is heard once. It is not also a live region; that would say it twice.
- **Diff lines are a list, not a table.** A table made a screen reader say "row 14 of 52, column 3" before every line. Each line has a +/− glyph, a wash and visually hidden "Added:"/"Removed:". Line numbers and glyphs are `select-none` and `aria-hidden`, so a copied hunk is code.
- **Hunk toggles are named by their visible text.** An `aria-label` failed axe’s label-content-name-mismatch: a voice-control user says what they see.
- **Split is a container query.** `layout="split"` sets old against new once the diff itself is 48rem wide, so a diff in a side panel stays unified.
- Paths, values and ranges are literals with `dir="ltr"`. Under forced colours the frames keep a 1px inset so their outline is not painted over.

## Usage

### When to use

- An agent proposes edits to files or records that a person must approve before they are applied.
- The reviewer needs the diff, the agent’s reasons in its own words and the decision in one place.
- Showing a record change field by field, before and after, with FieldChanges rather than a JSON diff.

### When not to

- One tool call that needs a yes or no before it runs; the approval belongs on the call. Use [Tool call](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-tool-call--overview.md).
- Confirming a destructive action the person started themselves. Use [AlertDialog](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-dialog--overview.md).
- Code or a payload that is not a change. Use [CodeBlock](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-code--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Keep Approve, Request changes and Reject the same size and variant, as the component draws them.
- Don’t: Restyle Approve as the ink primary or Reject as a quiet link; a nudged approval is a defect.
- Do: Pass the agent’s explanation as summary, so the reviewer can judge its reasoning.
- Don’t: Show the diff alone and leave the reviewer to guess why the agent made the change.

### Content

- Title the change by what it does, “Roll the help panel out to Starter”, not by the files it touches.
- Name a record by its type and key, so each field change has an owner: “Feature flag help_panel_v2”.
- A reason for a no says what is wrong and what would make it acceptable, because the agent acts on it.

## API

### `ChangeCount` (component)

"+12 −3": the size of a change, at a glance.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `added` (required) | `number` |  | Lines added. Shown as "+n" and said as "n lines added". |
| `removed` (required) | `number` |  | Lines removed. Shown as "−n" and said as "n lines removed". |

`className`, `ref`, `id` and the other DOM props go to `<span data-slot="change-count">`.

### `ChangeReview` (component)

An agent proposes a change; a person reviews it and decides.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` (required) | `string` |  | Who proposed it — "Cayuco research agent". |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | What the change does, in words — "Roll the help panel out to Starter". |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The change itself: `FileDiff`s, `FieldChanges`, or both. |
| `decision` | `ChangeDecision \| null` |  | Controlled decision. `null` means undecided. |
| `defaultDecision` | `ChangeDecision \| null` | `null` | Uncontrolled starting decision. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3` | `3` | Heading level for the proposal's title. Defaults to 3; use 2 when the review is the page's main subject. |
| `model` | `string` |  | The model identifier, set as a literal. |
| `onDecide` | `((status: ChangeDecisionStatus, reason: string) => void)` |  | Called with a valid decision only: never for a rejection without a reason. |
| `reviewer` | `string` |  | Who decided, shown with the outcome — "M. Herrera". |
| `summary` | `ReactNode` |  | The agent's explanation of the change, in its own words. Set as prose. |

`className`, `ref`, `id` and the other DOM props go to `<section data-slot="change-review">`.

### `FieldChanges` (component)

A change to a record rather than a file: a feature flag, a customer's plan, a schedule. Each field reads before → after.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` (required) | `readonly FieldChange[]` |  | The fields that changed, each as before → after. Leave out the fields that did not change: the list is the change, not the record. |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | What the record is — "Feature flag help_panel_v2". |
| `headingLevel` | `3 \| 4 \| 5` | `4` | Heading level for the record's title. Defaults to 4, under a `ChangeReview` heading. |

`className`, `ref`, `id` and the other DOM props go to `<section data-slot="field-changes">`.

### `FileDiff` (component)

One file's change, as a reviewer reads it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` (required) | `string` |  | The file's path after the change. |
| `defaultCollapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Start with every hunk collapsed. |
| `diff` | `string` |  | One file's unified diff, as `git diff` prints it. |
| `headingLevel` | `3 \| 4 \| 5` | `4` | Heading level for the path. Defaults to 4, under a `ChangeReview` heading. |
| `hunks` | `readonly (DiffHunk \| DiffHunkInput)[]` |  | Or the hunks, structured. Wins over `diff`. |
| `kind` | `FileChangeKind` | `modified` | What happened to the file, shown as a mark and a word in the header. Defaults to `modified`; a `renamed` file with no hunks says so instead of showing an empty diff. |
| `layout` | `"unified" \| "split"` | `unified` | `unified` is one column of lines. `split` sets old against new side by side once the diff's container is 48rem wide, and stays unified below that — a phone has no room for two columns of code. |
| `previousPath` | `string` |  | The path before a rename. |

`className`, `ref`, `id` and the other DOM props go to `<section data-slot="file-diff">`.

### `countChanges` (function)

Lines added and removed across hunks — the figures `ChangeCount` shows.

### `parseUnifiedDiff` (function)

Parse the hunks of one file's unified diff. File headers (`diff --git`, `index`, `---`, `+++`) are skipped — the path is `FileDiff`'s own prop — and so is `\ No newline at end of file`, which is a fact about bytes, not a line anyone reviews.

Types: `ChangeCountProps`, `ChangeDecision`, `ChangeDecisionStatus`, `ChangeReviewProps`, `FieldChange`, `FieldChangesProps`, `FileChangeKind`, `FileDiffProps`, `DiffHunk`, `DiffHunkInput`, `DiffLine`, `DiffLineKind`

## Accessibility

### Keyboard

| Key | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves to the Reason field, then to Approve, Request changes and Reject. |
| Enter or Space | Decides with the focused button. |
| Enter or Space | On a hunk header in a diff, folds or unfolds that hunk. |

### Mola handles

- Reject or Request changes with an empty reason states the error in words, marks the field invalid, moves focus to it and does not call `onDecide`.
- The outcome replaces the form and takes focus once, so it is heard once; a decision that arrives already made does not take focus.
- The three decisions sit in a group named “Decision”, each a glyph and a word of the same weight.
- Diff lines are list items that say “Added:” or “Removed:”, line numbers and +/− glyphs are hidden from screen readers, and counts are read as “12 lines added, 3 lines removed”.

### You handle

- Give the change a `title` that says what it does, and pass `reviewer` so the outcome says who decided.
- Set `headingLevel` on the review and its diffs so the headings fit the page outline.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 8 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: yes, every key in the table is pressed.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
